title: CHA2DS2-VASc and HAS-BLED: Different Purposes
subject: Clinical Scoring Systems
preview: CHA2DS2-VASc estimates thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation; HAS-BLED identifies modifiable bleeding risk factors.
quickRevision: CHA2DS2-VASc estimates thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation; HAS-BLED identifies modifiable bleeding risk factors.
Bleeding-risk assessment should prompt risk modification rather than automatically withholding indicated anticoagulation.
Guideline thresholds and use of sex-based points vary with updated pathways; verify the current regional recommendations.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: CHA2DS2-VASc estimates thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation; HAS-BLED identifies modifiable bleeding risk factors.
The two scores answer different questions and should not be directly subtracted from each other.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: High bleeding risk demands careful follow-up and correction of modifiable risks, not a simplistic no-anticoagulation rule.
